name: Canto Now Playing
author: Gustavo Costa (gusthx)
description: What Canto is playing, in the bar: title and artist, or the current synced lyric line, with play/pause, next/previous and a small popup with the cover.

barWidget.description: Now playing in Canto, or the current synced lyric line. Click to play/pause, scroll to skip, right-click for the popup.

schema.label: Show the synced lyric line
schema.description: Show the current lyric line instead of the title while one is available. Needs Visual Bridge on in Canto (Preferences, Integrations, Visual Bridge).

schema.label: Maximum width
schema.description: The widest the text in the bar gets, in pixels before scaling. Longer text is cut with an ellipsis.
